title: NousViz Entitlement Contract
description: Versioned, additive-only document describing what a managed customer is allowed. Produced by nousviz-cloud (the control panel); consumed by the app's enterprise entitlement client (MC-601). The CONSUMER MUST TOLERATE UNKNOWN FIELDS for forward-compatibility — additionalProperties is true throughout so a newer producer never breaks an older consumer.

version.description: Contract schema version. Bumped ONLY for breaking shape changes (removing/repurposing a field). Additive changes — new optional fields, new feature flags — do NOT bump it.

tier.description: Plan tier. Informational + the key for one-off overrides. The limits below are authoritative — never infer limits from the tier name.

max_users.description: Maximum users. null = unlimited. Enforced at invite/accept (MC-602). Existing users over a lowered limit are GRANDFATHERED, never deleted.

max_plugins.description: Maximum installed plugins. null = unlimited. Enforced at install (MC-603). Already-installed plugins grandfathered. Backup dirs (B276) must not count toward this.

plugins.description: Allowed plugins. "*" = unrestricted; otherwise an allowlist of plugin slugs. Enforced at install (MC-603), INDEPENDENT of B305 per-user visibility (this is what the PLAN permits; B305 is what a USER may see).

smtp.description: Managed mail relay. null = the instance uses the customer's own SMTP config (default fallback). When present, outbound mail routes through these credentials instead (MC-604). Delivered over the HMAC-signed channel; treat password as a secret.

ssl.description: "wildcard" = cloud auto-issues a wildcard cert; the managed instance SKIPS the SSL wizard (MC-104). "customer" = the customer manages their own certificate.

features.description: Optional feature flags. ADDITIVE: unknown flags are tolerated and treated as off. Consumed via features.has_*() (MC-605). Community edition ignores this block entirely (everything is on).
